Gauth is the premier AI study companion powered by advanced multi-model AI! Trusted by millions, Gauth provides comprehensive conceptual learning support across all subjects and grades. Experience a smarter way to master your studies and elevate your academic understanding today!
KEY FEATURES
► STEP-BY-STEP LEARNING GUIDANCE Master complex concepts with ease. Gauth AI provides detailed, step-by-step explanations and process guidance to clarify study concepts, helping you build a solid academic foundation and learn problem-solving skills with interactive AI explanations.
► AI LIVE TUTOR: INTERACTIVE VOICE & WHITEBOARD Stuck on a challenging topic? Our AI Live Tutor is available anytime via voice. Watch as academic concepts are simplified on a virtual whiteboard for an intuitive, personalized learning experience.
► SMART STUDY CONVERTER: TRANSFORM YOUR NOTES Turn your notes, audio, or lecture links into powerful study tools. Gauth helps you review effectively by generating personalized quizzes and flashcards to reinforce memory and boost exam preparation.
► DEEPTHINKING: INSPIRED LEARNING Powered by advanced AI models, DeepThinking mode dives deeper into subjects to inspire curiosity, analyze study challenges, and foster a better understanding of the "why" behind the facts.
► 24/7 EXPERT ACADEMIC SUPPORT In addition to AI, gain round-the-clock access to a global network of subject matter experts for detailed conceptual walkthroughs and homework guidance in Math, Science, and more.
► SEAMLESS STUDYING & SYSTEMATIC FORMATTING Import your study materials, and Gauth's intelligent recognition tools will organize the information with clear formatting and structured explanations for a stress-free learning experience.
► ALL-IN-ONE STUDY TOOLBOX Supercharge productivity with built-in tools for Reading, Writing, and Focus. Includes an AI writing assistant for grammar checks and structure optimization, text simplifier, and an integrated study timer.
SUBJECTS COVERED
Math, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, and Others.
► MATH TOPICS FOR CONCEPTUAL GUIDANCE: • Math Word problems • Algebra (Real/Complex Numbers, Arithmetic, Set theory, Expressions, Logarithms) • Function (Linear, Quadratic, Polynomial, Exponential, Rational, Logarithmic, Inverse) • Geometry (Plane & Solid, Algebra & lines, Space Lines/Planes, Transformations) • Trigonometry (Ratios, Law of Sines/Cosines, Reciprocal Properties) • Calculus (Derivatives, Integrals, Limits, Tangent/Area problems) • Statistics & Data Analysis (Probability, Data Representation, Poisson/Normal Distribution) • Matrix (Matrix Algebra, Linear Equations) & Logic (Reasoning & Proof)
